$join: A tanky Templar for duels and group PvP: lock enemies down with stuns, knockdowns and debuffs, survive on HP, Block and Defense, and let a Judgment-centred macro do the damage. The article gives separate specialization and stigma sets for 1v1 and group fights — this guide follows the 1v1 set, the group changes are in the tips.

tips.title: Role in PvP
tips.text: Control comes first: AoE stuns, displacement and debuffs set enemies up for your team's AoE damage. In a duel the Templar wins by outlasting the opponent on HP, Defense, Block and damage mitigation.

tips.title: Macro setup
tips.text: Key-bind priority: Judgment first, the other Judgment triggers next, Pummel last. Set Macro Display MS to half your ping. With Shield Smite's AoE Stun option, take Shield Smite out of the queue and save it for several targets.

tips.title: Stigma timing
tips.text: Shield of Protection forces a block, which procs Annihilate. Put Executing Blade on the target just before a fully charged Punishment. In group fights Doom Shield is for chasing, and Comrade in Arms waits for the moment your team commits — its cooldown can't be reduced.

tips.title: Group PvP variant
tips.text: Stigmas: Doom Shield, Comrade in Arms, Empyrean Lord's Punishment (extra stun chance, combos with Shield Smite) and Grapple (pulls up to four enemies); Assault Fury or Nezekan's Shield as swaps. Specializations change on three skills: Warding Strike adds the party damage-tolerance option (5), Shield Smite takes AoE Stun (5) with +1s Stun, and Pummel trades its fewer-targets bonus for a cooldown option.

tips.title: Passives
tips.text: Fury first, then Impact Hit, Punishing Benediction and Insulting Roar. The rest of the points go into the defensive passives.

tips.title: Gear, Pantheon and Arcana
tips.text: Weapon and armor manastones: PvP Accuracy, PvP Attack, PvP Block, PvP Defense; accessory soulstones: Attack, Defense, Block, HP. Soul-bind lines carry Fury, Judgment and Punishment levels. Pantheon order: Time, Life, Freedom, Justice — survivability first. Arcana lines: Punishment, Judgment and Fury.

guides.name: PvP Burst and Control — Fextralife

$join: A disruptive frontline bruiser for duels and Abyss skirmishes. It catches targets with Poach or Doom Shield, chains stuns and knockdowns into Annihilate and Executing Blade, and keeps healers in check with Debilitating Smash. Accuracy comes first, then PvP Damage Tolerance and Status Effect Resist.

tips.title: Build idea
tips.text: Long-range hooks, gap closers, defense reduction and anti-heal make the Templar a frontline disruptor in duels and Abyss skirmishes. Accuracy is the top stat so that the control actually lands.

tips.title: Judgment windows
tips.text: Judgment's cooldown removal (option 5) only works inside a trigger window, so spread Shield Smite, Warding Strike and Doom Shield out and spend the Judgment casts each of them opens.

tips.title: Punishment against kiters
tips.text: Against ranged opponents who keep their distance, use Punishment's mobile-cast option; when you can safely charge in place, the damage-over-time option is the alternative.

tips.title: Stigma swaps
tips.text: Comrade in Arms (takes damage for the backline) or Second Skin (more PvP Damage Tolerance) can replace Nezekan's Shield or Empyrean Lord's Punishment.

tips.title: Defensive timing
tips.text: Pop Nezekan's Shield before you engage or as soon as you are focused, and keep Defiance for hard crowd control.

$join: In PvP the Templar wins by forcing bad fights on the enemy: pull a target with Poach, cut its healing with Debilitating Smash and coordinate the kill — sometimes guarding your own healer matters more than chasing a damage dealer. Control reliability and survival come before raw damage. This guide follows the 1v1 / Arena setup; the 5v5 variant is in the tips.

tips.title: Role in PvP
tips.text: Force bad fights: pull targets, cut their healing and coordinate damage with your team. Guarding your own healer is sometimes worth more than chasing a damage dealer, and you should never be the easy crowd-control target yourself.

tips.title: Don't hit into Defiance
tips.text: Attacking into a Defiance immunity window wastes your control — wait it out, then chain stun, knockdown and Judgment.

tips.title: Keep it manual
tips.text: Targeting, movement, Defiance, Grapple and defensive cooldowns stay manual; a short macro for Debilitating Smash and its follow-ups is fine, a fully automated PvP combo is not.

tips.title: 5v5 / Abyss variant
tips.text: Stigmas: Grapple, Empyrean Lord's Punishment, Comrade in Arms and Doom Shield — the article calls it a specialised setup, not settled meta; swap a slot for Shield of Protection or Nezekan's Shield if the team needs defence. Stat order: Status Effect Resist, PvP Damage Tolerance, HP, Status Effect Chance, PvP Damage Boost. Agree on a target, such as the enemy healer, before pulling.

tips.title: Theostones and manastones
tips.text: A Theostone with a control or disruption effect can beat a small damage gain, and two identical Theostones don't stack. HP manastones are the safe PvP pick; Critical Hit Resist is situational.
